results.title: State’s first science college, AIIMS-level Ayurvedic institute to be set up in Hamirpur: CM
results.description: The first science college of the state will be set up in Hamirpur at an estimated cost of Rs 100 crore, said Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu while speaking at the annual function of Netaji Subhash Chander Bose Government Postgraduate Degree College in the district on Friday.
